meta.name: Dhaka Local Bus Route and Fare Database
meta.language: Stop and bus names in English as in the source list; bus names also in Bangla. Query in either.
meta.purpose: One file an app or an AI model can read to answer: from stop A to stop B, which local buses run, where to change if there is no direct bus, and roughly what it costs.

sources.what: Local Bus Route List of Dhaka (user-supplied attachment.txt)
sources.used_for: Every bus, its stops in order, type, first and last bus time.

sources.what: Government gazette of 23 September 2026 raising bus fares by Tk 0.17 per km, effective 22 September 2026, as reported by UNB (https://unb.com.bd/category/Bangladesh/govt-issues-gazette-raising-bus-minibus-fares-by-tk-017-per-km/196049) and Prothom Alo (https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/k3n86iluhg)
Dhaka Bus Route & Fare Finder project data (user ZIP): OCR of the dhakatc.com Local Bus page, 176 buses, 273 stops, with curated aliases, groups and landmarks.
sources.used_for: Cross-checks, site service_type and Bangla names, spelling variants (aliases), area groups, landmark hints. Its own caveats: 80 buses have page gaps, 58 stop names were seen once, no fares and no times.

known_limits: The BRTA fare PDF the user supplied could NOT be read: the text copy was blank, and the file could not be downloaded from this environment. If it contains stop-to-stop fares, those are not in this file. Fares here are computed from the per-km rate, not copied from a chart.

The route list has no distances. Distances come from approximate stop coordinates (lat/lng) typed from general knowledge, not from a map service. Each stop has coord_confidence: H (well-known landmark, within about 300 m), M (area is right, within about 1 km), L (guess, can be off by 2 km or more, mostly outer areas like Ashulia, Gazipur, Keraniganj, Narayanganj). Replace L and M coordinates with real ones before trusting fares on those stops.
Fares are estimates, usually within a few taka for short city trips and less reliable for L stops. Conductors may charge a rounded amount. Show the user est_fare_tk as 'about'.
The route list shows only major stops. A bus can also stop between two listed stops, and may skip some listed ones.
Every route is treated as running both directions, as the source states.

Buses are listed in the source as Semi-Seating or Seating. No AC buses are marked except Trust Transport (AC). The per-km rate in fare_rules applies to ordinary diesel buses; AC and gas-run buses are outside it.
Azmeri Glory Limited says its last bus is 12:00 PM (noon); probably a typo for midnight. Flagged in that bus's notes.

Some source names are probably typos and were merged: Sayapabad = Sayedabad, Golshan 1 = Gulshan 1, Jashimuddin = Jashimuddin (Uttara), Malibaag Moor = Malibagh, and Kuril Chourasta / Kuril Flyover = Kuril Bishwa Road. 'Konabari' appears twice in the source: near Mirpur and in Gazipur. They were split into konabari_mirpur and konabari_gazipur by the neighbouring stops.
Basumati Transport and Bashumoti look like two listings of a similar service. Both are kept.

Merged with the OCR project data (v0.2). 175 of its 176 buses were matched to a bus here. 53 matched buses disagree on stops: see review_queue.bus_stop_disagreements. This file keeps the route-list version of those and does not guess.

The OCR project's own rules say: no fares, no travel times, only same-stop transfers. This file differs on purpose, because the owner asked for fares (estimates), operating hours and transfer advice. If you build the OCR project's UI, hide est_fare_tk and first_bus/last_bus there.
Adamjee School and Adamijee College are different places and are kept as two stops. Bus 4 No. Alike was switched to Adamijee College to follow the OCR data. Verify.
The OCR data's service_type (for example 'Semi-Sitting Service (Check System)') is kept per bus in cross_ref.service_type_site. The route list's own type stays in type.

check_figures.note: The two sources give different counts. The route list has more buses (183 vs 176); the OCR data has page gaps. Neither is proven complete.

fare_rules.applies_to: Ordinary diesel buses in Dhaka and Chattogram metro areas. Not gas-run buses, not AC buses.

formula_used_here.ride_km: max(sum of straight-line hops between the bus's own listed stops x 1.2, straight-line distance between the two stops x 1.35)
formula_used_here.journey_fare_tk: sum of ride_fare_tk over each bus taken. Every bus change pays a new minimum of Tk 10.
formula_used_here.why_two_distances: A bus that lists few stops would otherwise look shorter than a bus on the same road that lists many. The straight-line floor keeps the fare consistent across buses.

how_to_search: 1. Resolve the user's typed place to stop ids in this order: exact name_en or aliases (aliases include OCR and site spellings) -> landmarks[].query_names -> stop_groups[].name_en (then list the group's stops and ask which one; never search all combinations) -> nearest stop by coordinates.
2. 'Adamjee' matches two different places (adamjee_school, adamijee_college). Show both and let the user pick.
3. Direct: every bus whose stops list has both ids. Buses run both directions. Rank by estimated fare, then fewer stops.

4. One change: bus A has the from-stop, bus B has the to-stop, change at a shared stop id. Only the same stop id counts as a change point; do not assume walking between nearby stops. Keep the cheapest few, at most one per change stop.
5. Two changes only if there is no direct and no one-change result (breadth-first over shared stops).
6. If I name a change point (for example 'break the journey at Mirpur 14'), force that change and show both legs.
7. Check the time against first_bus/last_bus. Skip buses that are not running now. Buses with null times (ocr_ ids) have unknown hours: show them with 'hours unknown'.
8. Show: bus names (English and Bangla), board at, get off at, stops between, change at, estimated fare per leg and total, with 'about Tk X'.
9. If a bus has cross_ref.ocr_page_gaps > 0, or appears in review_queue.bus_stop_disagreements, add 'data may be incomplete (ডেটা অসম্পূর্ণ হতে পারে)' to that leg.
10. Landmarks are suggestions, not source data: label them 'Suggestion, not source data (পরামর্শ, উৎস ডেটা নয়)'.
11. If nothing is found, say so ('ডেটায় এই দুই স্থানের মধ্যে নিশ্চিত যাত্রাপথ নেই'). Do not make up a route.
